brief.headline: Ask for ₹32.69 L/year off your laminate bill — we're paying more than we should, and we're their biggest customer at 9.72% of their sales.

priceAsk.summary: Cut our laminate price to match Shrinath Roto Pack Pvt Ltd — that's ₹290.00/KG on our top SKUs
priceAsk.basis: We're paying ₹294.03–₹308.30/KG for the same sachets Shrinath supplies at ₹290.00/KG. The market research puts pharma ORS laminate at ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg) — our current price sits at the top end, so there's room to come down. We're 9.72% of their ₹291.36 Cr revenue — big enough to demand our best-in-house price.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 30 days to 15 days — in exchange for hitting the ₹290/KG target
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days faster frees up ₹1.16 Cr of our cash, but their cash is stuck for 81 days (versus 46 days at similar firms), so early payment is worth roughly 4.38% to them — offer the speed for the price cut.

brief.financialLeverage: They make only ₹1.10 of profit on every ₹100 they sell (1.1%), half what similar firms keep (2.1%), so they run tight and can't afford big price hits. But their cash is tied up for 81 days, much longer than the 46 days typical for peers, meaning cash is tight for them and faster payment has real value. We are 9.72% of their total sales (₹28.31 Cr out of ₹291.36 Cr) — losing us would hurt. Their rating is CRISIL BB+ / Stable, but the agency marked 'issuer not cooperating,' so the numbers may be stale — treat their health as uncertain and keep the backup plan front and center.

evidence.point: We pay ₹32.69 L/year more than the lowest price we already have
Our top laminate SKU costs ₹294.03/KG here vs ₹290.00/KG at Shrinath — a 1.4% gap costing us ₹11.83 L/year
Market ask for pharma ORS laminate runs ₹205–305/kg, typical ₹250/kg — our ₹294–₹308 sits at the top of fair range
We are 9.72% of everything they sell
Their cash is stuck for 81 days, longer than the 46 days peers take — so they value quick payment
They keep only 1.1% profit, half the peer median of 2.1% — margins are paper-thin

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter, already a tiny FDC supplier — proven and scalable for laminate sachets.

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant doing both film and conversion — can second-source GEEP at scale.

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Part of the global Constantia group, makes pharma blister and sachet laminates in India — strong second-source candidate (health score D 31/100, revenue ₹222.04 Cr).

risks: They're 76% of our laminate spend (₹28.31 Cr) — we have no real backup today, so push carefully and line up Huhtamaki or UFLEX before you squeeze hard.
CRISIL BB+ / Stable rating comes with 'issuer not cooperating' — the agency did it without their help, so the financials may be out of date; treat their health as a question mark.
They report GST filing delays, EPF payment delays, and pending legal cases — compliance slip-ups that could disrupt supply if things get worse.
Profit is only 1.1% — a heavy price cut could tip them into loss and threaten our supply; win on payment speed and terms instead.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're reviewing laminate sourcing across all suppliers — you're getting ₹28.31 Cr from us this year, and we'd like to talk about bringing your price in line with the ₹290/KG we pay Shrinath and tightening payment terms to help your cash flow.
